The model predicts that the announcement day returns for a dividend increase are inversely related to measures of informed trading and decreasing in the level of buy demand relative to sell demand. Further, the model hypothesizes that more informed trading results in larger dividend increases. Empirical tests confirm these predictions. (C) 2002 Published by Elsevier Science B.V.

### 586. Do US stock prices deviate from their fundamental values? Some new evidence

**相关性得分**: 3.5分

**作者**: Zhong, MS, Darrat, AF, Anderson, DC

**匹配关键词**: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(alternative)

**【中文翻译】**

我们提出了一种新方法来检验Fama（1991）的论点，即现值模型（PVM）应当被时变的预期通胀所增补，以更充分地解释实际股价行为。与其他方法不同，我们的检验方法能够区分Shiller（1981）的超额价格波动假说和Marsh与Merton（1986）的股利平滑假说。我们在一个多变量PVM协整框架下，将股价水平（而非方差）分解为其基本面成分和非基本面成分，并利用Gonzalo和Granger（1995）程序来正式检验非基本面成分的统计显著性。我们来自二战后时期月度数据的结果不支持通胀增补的PVM，因为非基本面成分继续达到显著性。这一发现在替代的模型设定和数据频率下依然存在。传统的、理性预期的PVM模型显然未能充分解释观察到的市场行为，这提供了另一项支持Shiller（1981）关于某种形式市场“非理性”信念的证据。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We propose a new methodology to test Fama's [J. Finance 46 (1991) 1575] contention that the present value model (PVM) should be augmented by time-varying expected inflation to more adequately account for actual stock price behavior. Unlike other methods, our testing approach can distinguish between the excess-price movement hypothesis of Shiller [Am. Econ. Rev. 71 (1981) 421] and the dividend-smoothing hypothesis of Marsh and Merton [Am. Econ. Rev. 76 (1986) 483]. We decompose the levels (as opposed to the variances) of stock prices into their fundamental and non-fundamental elements in the context of a multivariate PVM co-integrating framework and utilize the Gonzalo and Granger [J. Bus. Econ. Stat. 13 (1995) 27] procedure to formally test for the statistical significance of the non-fundamental component. Our results from monthly data for the post-WWII period do not support the inflation-augmented PVM since the non-fundamental component continues to achieve significance. This finding persists under alternative model specifications and data frequencies. The apparent failure of the traditional, rational-expectation, PVM model to adequately account for observed market behavior provides another piece of evidence supportive of Shiller's [Am. Econ. Rev. 71 (1981) 591] belief in some form of market "irrationality". (C) 2002 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved.

The resultant shifts in traders' demands amplify any supply shock-induced price changes, We develop an infinite horizon noisy rational expectations model and calibrate, simulate, and test it using U.S. stock market data. The price variability in a heterogeneous information economy is shown to be 20% to 46% higher than in an otherwise equivalent economy in which all signals are publicly announced.

### 588. On Comparing Cash Flow and Accrual Accounting Models for Use in Equity Valuation: A Response to Lundholm and O'Keefe (CAR, Summer 2001)

**相关性得分**: 3.5分

**作者**: Penman, SH

**期刊**: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH　|　**年份**: 2001　|　**DOI**: 10.1506/DT0R-JNEG-QL60-7CBP

**匹配关键词**: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow)

**【中文翻译】**

人们普遍宣称，用于股权估值的现金流会计方法和权责发生制会计方法必须始终产生等价的估值。例如，Lundholm和O'Keefe（2001）近期的一篇论文宣称，由于这种等价性，从估值模型的实证比较中无可学习。因此他们否定了近期研究，这些研究表明权责发生制会计的剩余收益模型和收益资本化模型在一系列条件下的表现优于现金流或股利贴现模型。本文用例子证明这一宣称是错误的。实践不可避免地涉及在有限的、截断的视野上进行预测，而模型中所规定的会计——特别是现金会计与权责发生制会计——与有限视野预测下的估值相关。实际上，选择估值模型的问题就是设定形式化会计的问题，因此对于有限视野预测，人们不可能对会计漠不关心。

**【英文摘要原文】**

A claim is commonly made that cash flow and accrual accounting methods for valuing equities must always yield equivalent valuations. A recent paper by Lundholm and O'Keefe 2001, for example, claims that, because of this equivalence, there is nothing to be learned from empirical comparison of valuation models. So they dismiss recent research that has shown that accrual accounting residual income models and earnings capitalization models perform, over a range of conditions, better than cash flow or dividend discount models. This paper demonstrates, with examples, that the claim is misguided. Practice inevitably involves forecasting over finite, truncated horizons, and the accounting specified in a model - cash versus accrual accounting in particular - is pertinent to valuation with finite-horizon forecasting. Indeed, the issue of choosing a valuation model is an issue of specifying pro forma accounting, and so, for finite-horizon forecasts, one cannot be indifferent to the accounting.

**期刊**: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH　|　**年份**: 2001　|　**DOI**: 10.1506/W13B-K4BT-455N-TTR2

**匹配关键词**: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow)

**【中文翻译】**

本文考察了为何从业者和研究者在使用贴现现金流（CF）模型与剩余收益（RI）模型时会得到不同的股权价值估计。两个模型都源于同一个基础假设——即价格是预期未来净股利按股权资本成本贴现的现值——但在实践和研究中它们经常产生不同的估计。我们认为，致力于比较这两个模型准确性的研究文献是被误导的；如果正确实施，两个模型对所有公司在所有年份都产生完全相同的估值。我们指出此前研究如何对这两个模型应用了不一致的假设，并表明这些看似微小的错误如何导致价值估计中出人意料的巨大差异。

**【英文摘要原文】**

This paper examines why practitioners and researchers get different estimates of equity value when they use a discounted cash flow (CF) model versus a residual income (RI) model. Both models are derived from the same underlying assumption - that price is the present value of expected future net dividends discounted at the cost of equity capital - but in practice and in research they frequently yield different estimates. We argue that the research literature devoted to comparing the accuracy of these two models is misguided; properly implemented, both models yield identical valuations for all firms in all years. We identify how prior research has applied inconsistent assumptions to the two models and show how these seemingly small errors cause surprisingly large differences in the value estimates.

This study investigates the excess funds hypothesis using samples of special dividends, regular dividend increases, and self-tender offers. All three types of firms tend to have funds in excess of industry norms before the events. The excess funds are largely nonrecurring for special dividend and self-tender offer firms and recurring for regular dividend increase firms. The analysis of the stock price reaction suggests that large incremental disbursements mitigate the agency problem associated with excess funds. In particular, the stock price reaction is positively related to excess funds for self-tender offers and large special dividends, but not for regular dividend increases (which tend to be smaller) or small special dividends.

A number of applications to diffusion models, including stochastic volatility, stochastic interest rate, and stochastic dividend rate models, and jump-diffusion models are examined.

We examine the relation between stock returns, measures of risk, and several non-risk security characteristics, including the book-to-market ratio, firm size, the stock price, the dividend yield, and lagged returns. Fama-MacBeth-type regressions using risk adjusted returns provide evidence of return momentum, size, and book-to-market effects, together with a significant and negative relation between returns and trading volume, even after accounting for the CK factors. When the analysis is repeated using the FF factors, we find that the size and book-to-market effects are attenuated, while the momentum and trading volume effects persist. The results indicate there is some small positive information transfer. The magnitude of information transfer is related to the degree of the dividend surprise, the recent dividend history of the other companies, and correlations in stock returns between the dividend announcer and the other companies. **匹配关键词**: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal)

**【中文翻译】**

我们研究了145家纽约证券交易所公司在连续九年或更长时间的增长后年度盈余下降时，管理者股利决策的信号内容。使用各种模型设定和有利股利信号的定义，我们几乎没有发现支持股利决策有助于识别未来盈余卓越的公司这一观点的证据。股利往往不是可靠的信号，因为（i）一种行为偏差（过度乐观）导致管理者在增长前景消退时高估未来盈余；以及（ii）管理者在增加股利时只作出适度的现金承诺，这削弱了此类信号的可靠性。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We study the signaling content of managers' dividend decisions for 145 NYSE firms whose annual earnings decline after nine or more consecutive years of growth. Using a variety of model specifications and definitions of favorable dividend signals, we find virtually no support for the notion that dividend decisions help identify firms with superior future earnings. Dividends tend not to be reliable signals because (i) a behavioral bias (overoptimism) leads managers to overestimate future earnings when growth prospects fade; and (ii) managers make only modest cash commitments when they increase dividends, undermining the reliability of such signals.

**匹配关键词**: 股利政策(stock repurchase)；影响机制(signal)

**【中文翻译】**

我们利用CUC International的经历来考察投资者沟通问题。CUC难以让投资者相信其营销支出是有利可图的投资，导致股票在相当长的一段时期内被错误估值。为解决这一问题，CUC采取了一项会计变更，然后进行了杠杆资本重组。随后，它加速偿还重组债务并启动了股票回购。CUC的经历表明，会计报告在投资者沟通中并不总是有效的。虽然财务信号更为有效，但其影响并不像此前研究所预测的那样即时。CUC案例表明，投资者沟通是未来研究的一个丰富领域。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We examine investor communication issues using the experience of CUC International. CUC had difficulty convincing investors that its marketing outlays were profitable investments, leading to stock misvaluation over an extended period. To resolve this problem, CUC adopted an accounting change and then underwent a leveraged recapitalization. Subsequently, it accelerated recap debt repayments and initiated a stock repurchase. CUC's experience suggests that accounting reports are not always effective in investor communication. While financial signals are more effective, their impact is not as immediate as predicted by prior research. The CUC case suggests that investor communications is a rich area for future research.

**【中文翻译】**

**【英文摘要原文】**

This study investigates the information conveyed by intrafirm exchange offers. I find that leverage increases and leverage decreases convey qualitatively different information. Leverage-increasing offers appear to lower investors' assessment of risk of the firm's common stock, but do not appear to change their expectations of cash flows; leverage-decreasing offers appear to lower investors' expected cash flows, but do not appear to change their assessment of risk. The nature of changes in leverage, capital outlays, and dividends is also asymmetric. Further, I find that, for leverage-increasing offers, corporate control activity does not explain the information content or its asymmetry.

**匹配关键词**: 股利政策(distribution)；影响机制(alternative)

**【中文翻译】**

本文考察了市场对首次增发（seasoned equity offerings）的反应与发行公司增长机会盈利能力的替代度量之间的关系。虽然样本发行在公告期预测误差与若干增长机会的事前度量之间表现出正向关系，但这种关系并非单调，并且似乎是由一小部分较年轻、较高增长的公司所驱动，这些公司的公告效应与零无显著差异。对于其余的样本公司，新投资的估计盈利能力与市场对所宣布的股权发行的反应之间没有关系。此外，无论投资机会预期多么有利可图，公告效应都是非正的。这些发现共同表明，投资机会在解释股权发行公告效应的横截面分布方面至多发挥次要作用。

This paper examines the relation between the market reaction to primary seasoned equity offerings and alternative measures of the profitability of the issuing firm's growth opportunities. While the sample offerings display a positive relation between announcement period prediction errors and several ex ante measures of growth opportunities, this relation is not monotonic and appears to be driven by a small subset of younger, higher growth firms, whose announcement effects are insignificantly different from zero. For the remainder of the sample firms, there is no relation between the estimated profitability of new investment and the market reaction to announced equity offerings. Moreover, announcement effects are nonpositive regardless of how profitable investment opportunities are expected to be. These findings collectively suggest that investment opportunities play, at best, a minor role in explaining the cross-sectional distribution of equity offering announcement effects.

**匹配关键词**: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(signal)

**【中文翻译】**

我们检验了若干IPO抑价模型的实证含义。与赢家诅咒假说相一致，我们表明在投资者事先知道他们不必与知情投资者竞争的市场中，IPO不存在抑价。我们还表明，由声誉良好的投资银行承销的IPO抑价显著更少，并在长期内表现显著更好。我们没有找到支持那些试图解释公司为何抑价的信号模型的实证证据。事实上，我们发现（1）抑价更多的公司返回再发行市场的频率更低、金额更小，相比抑价较少的公司；以及（2）抑价较少的公司经历更高的盈余并支付更高的股利，这与这些模型的预测相反。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We test the empirical implications of several models of IPO underpricing. Consistent with the winner's-curse hypothesis, we show that in markets where investors know a priori that they do not have to compete with informed investors, IPOs are not underpriced. We also show that IPOs under-written by reputable investment banks experience significantly less underpricing and perform significantly better in the long run. We do not find empirical support for the signaling models that try to explain why firms underprice. In fact, we find that (1) firms that underprice more return to the reissue market less frequently, and for lesser amounts, than firms that underprice less, and (2) firms that underprice less experience higher earnings and pay higher dividends, contrary to the models' predictions.

### 604. THE RATIONALITY OF EARLY EXERCISE DECISIONS - EVIDENCE FROM THE S-AND-P-100 INDEX OPTIONS MARKET

**相关性得分**: 3.5分

**作者**: DIZ, F, FINUCANE, TJ

**期刊**: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES　|　**年份**: 1993　|　**DOI**: 10.1093/rfs/6.4.765

**匹配关键词**: 股利政策(dividend)；影响机制(cash flow)

**【中文翻译】**

本研究对标准普尔100看跌期权和看涨期权的提前行权历史进行了全面的实证分析。尽管标准普尔100指数期权市场通常被认为是世界上最有效的期权市场，我们表明许多行权决策是低效的，因为它们发生在记录的买价大于行权价值之时。由于市场不完美，一些低效行权的情形仍然是理性的，但我们表明这些决策中有相当一部分显然是非理性的，因为通过卖出本可以实现更大的无风险净现金流。与此前关于提前行权的研究不同，我们对效率和据称导致有效市场的理性决策的检验是与模型无关的。我们还提供了关于股利和“通配符”对指数期权定价模型相对重要性的证据，并引入并记录了行权以避免价差间接成本这一选择的重要性。我们还发现存在显著的一周中不同日的行权效应，并对该效应给出了一些可能的解释。

**【英文摘要原文】**

This study provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of the early exercise history of S&P 100 put and call options. Even though the S&P 100 index options market is generally considered to be the most efficient options market in the world, we show that many exercise decisions are inefficient because they occur when recorded bids are greater than exercise values. Due to market imperfections, some of the cases of inefficient exercise are still rational, but we show that a substantial number of these decisions are clearly irrational, since it would have been possible to realize a larger riskless net cash flow by selling. Unlike previous studies of early exercise, our tests of efficiency and the rational decisions that presumably lead to efficient markets are model independent. We also provide evidence concerning the relative significance of dividends and the wild card to index option pricing models, and introduce and document the importance of the option to exercise and avoid the indirect costs of the spread. We also find evidence of a significant day-of-the-week exercise effect, and present some likely explanations for that effect.

This paper presents a dynamic asset-pricing model under asymmetric information. Investors have different information concerning the future growth rate of dividends. They rationally extract information from prices as well as dividends and maximize their expected utility. The model has a closed-form solution to the rational expectations equilibrium. We find that existence of uninformed investors increases the risk premium. Supply shocks can affect the risk premium only under asymmetric information. Information asymmetry among investors can increase price volatility and negative autocorrelation in returns. Less-informed investors may rationally behave like price chasers.

It also predicts that the price drop at issue announcement increases with the time since the last information release. These predictions are consistent with several recent empirical studies relating equity issues to earnings and dividend announcements.

### 609. Uncertainty and firm dividend policy-A natural experiment

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE　|　**年份**: 2017　|　**DOI**: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2016.11.008

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

我们考察了公司如何应对围绕美国税收政策变化的不确定性，即定于2011年1月1日和2013年1月1日生效的个人层面税率上调。我们提供的证据表明，公司会把握税收环境中的不确定性并针对预期的税收上调修正其股利政策。我们发现公司很可能在预期税收上调的一年前首次发放股利或大幅增加其现有股利数额。此外，在2012年，当股利税变动的不确定性远小于2010年时，公司不太可能首次发放常规股利，但更可能首次发放特别股利。结果表明，面临较少税收不确定性的公司不太可能对常规股利支付作出长期承诺，但更可能通过发放特别股利来利用最后时刻的低税收益。此外，对可能取消减税的反应在拥有高水平受税收影响所有权的公司中最强，这支持了以下论点：当面临政策不确定性时，公司从股东的角度出发为最坏情形（本例中即税收上调）做准备而行事。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We examine how firms respond to uncertainty around U.S. tax policy changes, namely the individual level tax rate increases set to take effect on January 1, 2011 and January 1, 2013. We provide evidence that firms time the uncertainty in the tax environment and revise their dividend policy to an expected tax increase. We find that firms are likely to initiate their dividends or intensively increase their existing dividend amount one year before the expected tax increase. In addition, in 2012 when there is much less uncertainty on dividend tax changes than in 2010, firms are less likely to initiate a regular dividend but are more likely to initiate special dividends. The results suggest that firms facing less tax uncertainty are less likely to make long-term commitments on regular dividend payments but are more likely to take advantage of the last-minute low tax benefits by issuing special dividends. Furthermore, the response to the possible elimination of a tax cut was strongest in firms with high levels of tax affected ownership, supporting the argument that when facing policy uncertainty, firms behave to prepare for the worst scenarios from the viewpoint of the shareholders, which in this case is a tax increase. A subset of these firms directly profit from repurchases, while other firms repurchase in order to improve the terms of a subsequent SEO. The possibility of repurchases reduces both SEOs and investment. Overall, our analysis highlights the importance of analyzing SEOs and repurchases in a unified framework.

本文研究了股东与债权人之间的利益冲突如何影响公司支付政策。使用同一家公司的贷款人与股权持有人之间的合并作为对股东-债权人冲突的冲击，我发现当股东与债权人之间的冲突较少时公司支付更少，这表明股东-债权人冲突诱使公司以债权人为代价支付更多。这一效应对于处于财务困境的公司更强。

This paper studies how the conflict of interest between shareholders and creditors affects corporate payout policy. Using mergers between lenders and equity holders of the same firm as shocks to the shareholder-creditor conflict, I find that firms pay out less when there is less conflict between shareholders and creditors, suggesting that the shareholder-creditor conflict induces firms to pay out more at the expense of creditors. The effect is stronger for firms in financial distress.

Our results hold in multiple robustness and endogeneity tests, including propensity score matching, difference-in-differences estimation, and an instrumental variable regression. Overall, our findings contribute to the literature highlighting the importance of CEOs' personal attributes for corporate decisions.

Additionally, this paper finds the tendency of dividend cuts upon technical default weakened after the repeal of the Glass-Steagall Act. ### 614. Dividend policy and the earned/contributed capital mix: a test of the life-cycle theory

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: DeAngelo, H, DeAngelo, L, Stulz, RM

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS　|　**年份**: 2006　|　**DOI**: 10.1016/j.jfineco.2005.07.005

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

与股利的生命周期理论相一致，当留存收益占总股权（及总资产）的很大部分时，支付股利的公开交易工业企业的比例很高，而当大部分股权是缴入而非赚取时，这一比例降至接近于零。我们观察到支付股利的决策与赚取/缴入资本比之间存在高度显著的关系，同时控制了盈利能力、增长、公司规模、总股权、现金余额和股利历史，这一关系对于股利首次发放和取消也成立。在我们的回归中，赚取/缴入资本比在数量上的影响大于盈利能力和增长机会的度量。我们记录到留存收益为负的公司大幅增加（从1978年占工业企业的11.8%增至2002年的50.2%）。在控制赚取/缴入资本比后，留存收益为负的公司从1970年代中期到2002年支付股利的倾向几乎没有变化，而那些赚取股权使其成为支付股利合理候选者的公司的倾向下降幅度是Fama和French（2000，《金融经济学杂志》76, 549-582）中总体下降幅度的两倍。最后，我们的模拟表明，如果成熟的老牌公司不曾支付股利，其现金余额将极其庞大而长期债务微不足道，从而赋予这些成熟公司的管理者极大的自由裁量权。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Consistent with a life-cycle theory of dividends, the fraction of publicly traded industrial firms that pay dividends is high when retained earnings are a large portion of total equity (and of total assets) and falls to near zero when most equity is contributed rather than earned. We observe a highly significant relation between the decision to pay dividends and the earned/contributed capital mix, controlling for profitability, growth, firm size, total equity, cash balances, and dividend history, a relation that also holds for dividend initiations and omissions. In our regressions, the mix of earned/contributed capital has a quantitatively greater impact than measures of profitability and growth opportunities. We document a massive increase in firms with negative retained earnings (from 11.8% of industrials in 1978 to 50.2% in 2002). Controlling for the earned/contributed capital mix, firms with negative retained earnings show virtually no change in their propensity to pay dividends from the mid-1970s to 2002, while those whose earned equity makes them reasonable candidates to pay dividends have a propensity reduction that is twice the overall reduction in Fama and French [2000, Journal of Financial Economics 76, 549-582]. Finally, our simulations show that, if well-established firms had not paid dividends, their cash balances would be enormous and their long-term debt trivial, thus granting extreme discretion to managers of these mature firms. We conclude that many studies should be revisited now that the SEC mandates disclosure of precise information about share repurchases in Forms 10-Q and 10-K. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. ### 616. Do Investors Value Dividend-Smoothing Stocks Differently?

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**期刊**: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE　|　**年份**: 2017　|　**DOI**: 10.1287/mnsc.2016.2551

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

人们广泛记录到管理者努力维持平滑的股利。然而，尚不清楚这种行为是否反映了投资者的偏好。在本文中，我们通过探究股利平滑对公司投资者客户群、股价和资本成本的含义，来研究投资者是否确实对股利平滑股票给予不同的估值。我们发现散户投资者不太可能持有股利平滑股票，而机构投资者、尤其是共同基金，则更可能持有。然而，这种偏好并未导致公司股利平滑度与其股票预期收益或市场价值之间存在任何可检测的关系。综合起来，证据表明公司会调整平滑股利的供给以匹配投资者的需求。股利平滑影响公司股东的构成，但对其股价影响甚微。

**【英文摘要原文】**

It is widely documented that managers strive to maintain smooth dividends. Yet, it is not clear if this behavior reflects investors' preferences. In this paper, we study whether investors indeed value dividend-smoothing stocks differently by exploring the implications of dividend smoothing for firms' investor clientele, stock prices, and cost of capital. We find that retail investors are less likely to hold dividend-smoothing stocks, while institutional investors, and especially mutual funds, are more likely. However, this preference does not result in any detectable relation between the smoothness of a firm's dividends and the expected return, or market value, of its stock. Together, the evidence suggests that firms adjust the supply of smoothed dividends to match investors' demand. Dividend smoothing affects the composition of a firm's shareholders but has little impact on its stock price.

本文在不确定性下的一般动态环境中研究债务契约的设计与估值。我们将近期公司金融文献的一些洞见纳入一个估值框架。基本框架是一个由债务契约条款和适用破产法所决定的展开式博弈。债权持有人和股权持有人以非合作方式行事。公司的重组边界被内生地确定。即使在很小的清算成本下，策略性债务偿还也会导致显著更高的违约溢价。绝对优先权的偏离和强制清算沿均衡路径发生。当公司具有较高的现金支付比率时，该设计倾向于强调更高的息票和偿债基金。

This article studies the design and valuation of debt contracts in a general dynamic setting under uncertainty. We incorporate some insights of the recent corporate finance literature into a valuation framework. The basic framework is an extensive form game determined by the terms of a debt contract and applicable bankruptcy laws. Debtholders and equityholders behave noncooperatively, The firm's reorganization boundary is determined endogenously. Strategic debt service results In significantly higher default premia at even small liquidation costs. Deviations from absolute priority, and forced liquidations occur along the equilibrium path. The design tends to stress higher coupons and sinking funds when firms have a higher cash payout ratio.

### 620. Flexibility and dividends

**【中文翻译】**

我们基于管理层重视经营灵活性这一思想，建立了一个公司股利政策模型。通过减少股利和保存现金，管理层增加了其灵活性。这提高了其投资于以下项目的能力：管理层认为这些项目从长远看对股东有利，但股东不会为其提供资本，因为股东认为这些项目会减损价值。然而，不支付股利的成本是当期股价的下降。管理层在股利的这两个方面之间进行权衡。灵活性考量帮助我们理解现有理论无法解释的股利政策的各个维度。我们的理论生成了众多可检验的预测，我们用数据加以对照。证据支持该模型。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We develop a model of corporate dividend policy based on the idea that management values operating flexibility. By reducing dividends and conserving cash, management increases its flexibility. This improves its ability to invest in projects that it believes are good for the shareholders in the long run but which shareholders would not provide the capital for because they think the projects are value reducing. However, the cost of not paying dividends is a reduction in the current stock price. Management trades off these two aspects of dividends. Flexibility considerations help us understand various dimensions of dividend policy that existing theories do not explain. Our theory generates numerous testable predictions that we confront with the data. The evidence is supportive of the model. (C) 2008 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.

本文考察了盈余信息在股利政策决定中的作用。我们将会计盈余分解为持久性成分和暂时性成分，并假设股利政策由可持续的持久性盈余所驱动。本文提出了两种持久性盈余的度量。第一种是通过一个随机水平移动ARMA模型从会计盈余中提取的持久性盈余变量。第二种度量是股价乘以资本成本。这两种持久性盈余度量被用于Marsh-Merton（1987）模型来解释公司股利行为，并比较其表现。实证估计采用广义摩擦法以考虑股利随时间的逐步变动。结果表明，从会计盈余数据中提取的持久性盈余度量比股价更好地解释了股利的动态行为。

This paper examines the role of earnings information in the determination of dividend policy. I We decompose accounting earnings into permanent and transitory components and postulate that dividend policy is driven by sustainable permanent earnings. Two measures of permanent earnings are proposed. The first is a permanent earnings variable extracted from accounting earnings by a random-level shift ARMA model. The second measure is stock price times cost of capital. These two permanent earnings measures are employed in the Marsh-Merton (1987) model to explain corporate dividend behavior and their performance is compared. A generalized friction method is adopted for empirical estimation to account for stepwise dividend movements over time. Results show that the permanent earnings measure extracted from accounting earnings data explains dividend dynamic behavior better than stock price.

### 622. Corporate liquidity and dividend policy under uncertainty (Reprinted from Journal of Banking and Finance, vol 75, pg 200-214, 2017)

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE　|　**年份**: 2017　|　**DOI**: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2017.01.021

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

我们考察了最优流动性（留存收益）和股利选择，纳入了具有违约风险和破产成本的债务融资，以及收入不确定性下的增长期权。我们重新审视了股利政策无关性的条件以及留存收益和股利更广泛的作用。在存在增长期权、高外部融资成本和低违约风险的情况下，留存收益对公司价值有净正向影响。高水平的留存收益增强了债务能力，但由于在违约情况下可能失去累积的现金余额而对股权价值有负向影响，除非被高外部融资成本所抵消。留存收益对股权和债务的相反方向效应造就了与公司价值之间的U形关系。该框架被扩展以分析管理层-股东冲突，证明管理者会累积高于最优水平的现金。（转载自《银行与金融杂志》，第75卷，第200-214页，2017年）

**【英文摘要原文】**

We examine optimal liquidity (retained earnings) and dividend choice incorporating debt financing with risk of default and bankruptcy costs as well as growth options under revenue uncertainty. We revisit the conditions for dividend policy irrelevancy and the broader role of retained earnings and dividends. Retained earnings have a net positive impact on firm value in the presence of growth options, high external financing costs and low default risk. High levels of retained earnings enhance debt capacity but have a negative effect on equity value due to the likelihood of losing accumulated cash balances in case of default, unless offset by high external financing costs. Opposite directional effects of retained earnings on equity and debt create a U-shaped relation with firm value. The framework is extended to analyze management-shareholder conflicts, demonstrating that managers accumulate higher than optimal cash. (C) 2017 Published by Elsevier B.V.

Nekrasov and Ogneva contribute by developing a methodology that allows us to integrate information about accounting attributes such as conservatism into our estimates of the growth rate in residual income. Hence, their methodology can be used to improve our understanding of the role that conservatism plays in determining growth. This, in turn, improves our ability to estimate key parameters such as value and the expected rate of return on equity capital.

As hypothesized by Miller and Modigliani, dividend reductions depend on whether earnings include unusual items that are likely to temporarily depress income. Dividend reductions are more likely given greater current losses, less negative unusual items, and more persistent earnings difficulties. Dividend policy has information content in that knowledge that a firm has reduced dividends improves the ability of current earnings to predict future earnings.

However, the wedge distorts the decisions of consumers not facing liquidity shocks, and the resulting equilibrium is inefficient. ### 642. Profit maximization and the market selection hypothesis

**【中文翻译】**

我们考察这样一个命题，即竞争性企业必须表现得仿佛在最大化利润；否则它们会破产，甚至无法在竞争性资本市场上获得融资。我们研究一个模型，其中一位企业家通过基于已实现（随机）盈利流提供一种“股利政策”，在竞争性资本市场上为一项有风险的企业筹集资金。我们表明，最大化贴现股利期望之和的企业家必定在有限时间内破产。另一方面，许多其他行为会产生正的预期利润并能够吸引投资资金，同时结果是有正概率永远存续。因此，如果新企业具有足够多样化的行为，那么即使有源源不断的新进入者，在长时间之后几乎所有存续的企业都不会是在最大化利润的企业。

We examine the proposition that competitive firms must behave as if they were maximizing profits; otherwise they would go bankrupt, or even fail to be financed in a competitive capital market. We investigate a model in which an entrepreneur raises funds for a risky enterprise on a competitive capital market, by offering a "dividend policy" based on the realized (stochastic) flow of earnings. We show that an entrepreneur who maximizes the expected sum of discounted dividends is sure to fail in finite time. On the other hand, many other behaviours yield positive expected profits and are able to attract investment funds, and yet result in a positive probability of surviving forever. As a consequence, if new firms have sufficiently diverse behaviours, then even if there is a constant stream of new entrants, after a long time practically all of the surviving firms will not hare been maximizing profits.

近期的研究和一些政策专家认为，股利表明更高质量的盈利。在本研究中，我们通过比较被指控会计舞弊的企业与未被指控会计舞弊的企业的股利政策，来检验这一推测。具体而言，我们考察被指控舞弊的企业是否与非舞弊企业一样有可能成为股利派发者，以及派息舞弊企业的管理者是否以与非舞弊企业管理者相同的速度提高股利。我们的数据显示，派息状态与实施会计舞弊的概率负相关。此外，我们还发现，在被指控舞弊期间，相对于未被指控舞弊的企业，被指控舞弊企业的盈利—股利关系更弱。最后，使用倾向得分匹配检验，数据提供证据表明被指控舞弊企业的管理者比未被指控舞弊企业的管理者更少地提高股利，这与被指控舞弊企业无法匹配未被指控舞弊企业的股利政策相一致。总体而言，我们的结果表明股利、尤其是股利增长，与更高的盈利质量相关。

Our data reveal that dividend paying status is negatively associated with the probability of committing accounting fraud. In addition, we also find that, during the alleged fraud period, the earnings-dividends relation is weaker for the alleged fraud firms relative to firms not accused of fraud. Finally, using propensity score match tests, the data provide evidence that managers of alleged fraud firms increase dividends less often than managers of firms not accused of fraud, consistent with the alleged fraud firms not being able to match the dividend policies of firms not accused of fraud. Overall, our results suggest that dividends, especially dividend increases, are associated with higher earnings quality.

本文考察对股利政策实质性转变的日内股价反应。结果表明，价格反应比Patell和Wolfson（1984）此前发现的要慢，而更接近Woodruff和Senchack（1988）在盈利公告中发现的情形。通过考察交易价格与同期买入价和卖出报价的接近程度，我们检验了可能的订单流失衡。虽然坏消息公告存在明显的订单流失衡，但股利增长样本则不然。这被解读为一种证据，表明对重大股利增长的价格反应通常是被预期到的。我们计算了15分钟的持有期收益，以度量公告期内均衡价格的变动。结果显示价格对正面公告快速调整，而对负面公告的调整则最多需要75分钟。最后，我们计算了15分钟滞后的买卖价差收益，以确定投资者能否对公告作出反应并赚取正收益。这些结果被发现取决于所做出的交易成本假设。

This paper examines the intraday stock price reaction to substantial shifts in dividend policy, The results indicate the price reaction to be slower than that previously found by Patell and Wolfson (1984) and closer to that found with earnings announcements by Woodruff and Senchack (1988). Possible order flow imbalances are examined by looking at the proximity of transaction prices to contemporaneous bid and ask quotes. While order flow imbalances are evident for bad news announcements, this is not the case for the dividend increase sample. This is interpreted as evidence that the price reaction to major dividend increases are in general anticipated. Fifteen minute holding period returns are computed to measure the movement of equilibrium prices during the announcement period. Results show a rapid adjustment of prices to positive announcements with adjustment to negative announcements taking up to 75 minutes. Finally, fifteen minute lagged bid-ask returns are calculated to determine whether an investor could respond to the announcement and earn positive returns. These results are found to be dependent on the transaction cost assumptions being made.

To examine the macroeconomic implications of a bubble, we use the bubble innovation as an instrument in a structural vector autoregression. Bank losses are primarily driven by write-downs of nonperforming assets, not asset sales during panics. Forceful liquidity-based interventions during crises predict only small, temporary increases in bank market value. Overall, these results suggest that bank losses during crises are not primarily due to temporary price dislocations. Early liquidity interventions can avert banking crises, but only under specific conditions. Once large bank equity declines have occurred, policy responses have historically failed to prevent persistent undercapitalization in the banking sector.

### 650. Landmines and Spatial Development

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Chiovelli, G, Michalopoulos, S, Papaioannou, E

**期刊**: ECONOMETRICA　|　**年份**: 2025　|　**DOI**: 10.3982/ECTA17951

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

在许多饱受冲突之苦的社区，地雷在敌对行动结束后很长时间内仍影响着数百万人的生活。然而，关于排雷作用的研究却很少。我们考察了莫桑比克排雷的经济后果，该国是唯一一个从1992年重度污染过渡到2015年无雷状态的国家。首先，我们呈现了自行汇编的、经地理坐标标注的疑似污染区域目录，以及排雷作业的详细记录。其次，事件研究分析揭示了排雷活动与随后当地经济表现（以灯光亮度反映）之间存在稳健的关联。在清除作业前的几年里经济活动并未回升，当作业方调查那些在先前勘测中被错误标记为污染的区域时经济活动也没有增加。第三，认识到排雷会重塑交通可达性，我们采用市场可达性方法来探究直接和间接效应。为增强识别性，我们分离出那些通过清除先前被认为安全、远离早期全国性勘测区域中的地雷所引起的市场可达性变化。第四，政策模拟揭示了清除作业带来的可观的全经济范围红利，但只有在计入市场可达性效应时才会显现，而这种效应远超直接的生产率联系。此外，政策反事实分析还揭示出，当排雷未优先打通交通路线时会产生显著的总体成本。这些结果为乌克兰及其他地方排雷项目的设计提供了启示，凸显了集中协调以及优先处理便利商贸区域的必要性。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Landmines affect the lives of millions in many conflict-ridden communities long after the end of hostilities. However, there is little research on the role of demining. We examine the economic consequences of landmine removal in Mozambique, the only country to transition from heavily contaminated in 1992 to mine-free in 2015. First, we present the self-assembled georeferenced catalog of areas suspected of contamination, along with a detailed record of demining operations. Second, the event-study analysis reveals a robust association between demining activities and subsequent local economic performance, reflected in luminosity. Economic activity does not pick up in the years leading up to clearance, nor does it increase when operators investigate areas mistakenly marked as contaminated in prior surveys. Third, recognizing that landmine removal reshapes transportation access, we use a market-access approach to explore direct and indirect effects. To advance on identification, we isolate changes in market access caused by removing landmines in previously considered safe areas, far from earlier nationwide surveys. Fourth, policy simulations reveal the substantial economywide dividends of clearance, but only when factoring in market-access effects, which dwarf direct productivity links. Additionally, policy counterfactuals uncover significant aggregate costs when demining does not prioritize the unblocking of transportation routes. These results offer insights into the design of demining programs in Ukraine and elsewhere, highlighting the need for centralized coordination and prioritization of areas facilitating commerce.

### 651. Limited Firm Insurance and Aggregate Implications

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Wang, YC

**期刊**: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE　|　**年份**: 2025　|　**DOI**: 10.1287/mnsc.2023.01627

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

本文研究金融冲击对企业保险、企业动态和宏观经济的影响。与文献的一个关键区别在于，企业在长期关系中向风险厌恶的工人提供工资保险合同。这类合同内生地对企业施加了一种缺乏灵活性的债务负债形式，使得金融净值有限的企业比其他企业更易受到冲击。在我们的模型中，企业具有异质的生产率和金融净值，同时企业还面临金融摩擦。劳动力市场中的搜寻与匹配内生地决定了工资合同的价值，从而决定了企业的负债水平。我们有三项新发现：（1）该定量模型的工资动态与实证研究中的结果一致，即对企业层面特质冲击存在显著的保险，并且在存在总体冲击时总体工资与GDP之间存在弱共动。（2）金融资源有限的企业受金融冲击的打击显著大于其他企业，对股利、信贷借款、企业价值和企业进入产生更大的负面影响；内生的工资保险也变得更加有限，并出现更多的雇佣关系解除。这些对企业和工人的影响与采用代表性企业或工人的标准模型不同，且无法由后者解释。（3）针对美国大衰退的定量分析表明，总体生产率冲击和金融冲击扮演不同角色；没有金融冲击，我们无法解释金融变量的动态，包括信贷借款减少、信用利差飙升以及股利支付大幅下降。最后，我们为模型的推论提供了微观层面的经验支持。

**【英文摘要原文】**

This paper studies the impacts of financial shocks on firm insurance, firm dynamics, and macroeconomic implications. A key departure from the literature is that firms provide wage insurance contracts to risk-averse workers in a long-term relationship. Such contracts endogenously impose a form of inflexible debt liability to firms, and make firms with limited financial net worth more vulnerable to shocks than others. In our model, firms have heterogenous productivity and financial net worth, and also firms face financial frictions. Search and matching in the labor market endogenously determines the value of wage contract, and thus the level of liability to the firm. We have three new findings: (1) The wage dynamics of the quantitative model are consistent with those in empirical studies, with significant insurance against firm-level idiosyncratic shocks, and also a weak comovement between aggregate wage and GDP when there are aggregate shocks. (2) Firms with limited financial resources are hit by financial shocks significantly more than others, with larger negative impacts on dividends, credit borrowing, firm value, and firm entry; the endogenous wage insurance also becomes more limited, and there are more separations. These impacts on both firms and workers are different from-and cannot be accounted for by-standard models with a representative firm or worker. (3) Quantitative exercises for the Great Recession in the United States suggest that aggregate productivity shocks and financial shocks play different roles; without financial shocks, we cannot account for the dynamics of financial variables, including the reduced credit borrowing, spikes in credit spreads, and large drops in dividend payments. Lastly, we provide microlevel empirical supports for our model implications.

### 652. Estimating the Effect of a Universal Cash Transfer on Birth Outcomes

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Wyndham-Douds, K, Cowan, SK

**期刊**: AMERICAN SOCIOLOGICAL REVIEW　|　**年份**: 2024　|　**DOI**: 10.1177/00031224241268059

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

在美国，婴儿的境况比其他高收入国家的同龄人更差，并且他们的福祉沿社会经济和种族界线呈现出鲜明的不平等。新生儿健康预示着成年后的福祉，使这些不平等具有深远影响。寻求改善新生儿健康和减少不平等的政策制定者和学者最近将目光转向直接现金转移作为一种可行的干预措施。我们考察了美国唯一的无条件现金转移——阿拉斯加永久基金分红（PFD），以了解给予孕妇金钱是否能改善其新生儿的健康。阿拉斯加自1982年以来每年向其居民支付可观的分红。分红金额逐年变化，且对阿拉斯加人和当地经济而言是外生的，这使我们能够作出因果判断。在考虑了生育选择之后，我们发现怀孕期间获得现金对新生儿健康没有实质性影响。当前理论侧重于购买力和地位机制来阐明金钱如何转化为健康，但它无法解释这一零结果。这一案例说明了当前理论的一个弱点：它没有为干预措施提供清晰的预期。我们提出了必须综合考虑的四个组成部分，以预测拟议的干预措施是否会奏效。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Babies in the United States fare worse than their peers in other high-income countries, and their well-being is starkly unequal along socioeconomic and racialized lines. Newborn health predicts adult well-being, making these inequalities consequential. Policymakers and scholars seeking to improve newborn health and reduce inequality have recently looked to direct cash transfers as a viable intervention. We examine the only unconditional cash transfer in the United States, the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD), to learn if giving pregnant people money improves their newborns' health. Alaska has paid its residents a significant dividend annually since 1982. The dividend's size varies yearly and is exogenous to Alaskans and the local economy, permitting us to make causal claims. After accounting for fertility selection, we find that receiving cash during pregnancy has no meaningful effect on newborn health. Current theory focuses on purchasing power and status mechanisms to delineate how money translates into health. It cannot illuminate this null finding. This case illustrates a weakness with current theory: it does not provide clear expectations for interventions. We propose four components that must be considered in tandem to predict whether proposed interventions will work.

### 653. Dividends, trust, and firm value

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Kapons, M, Kelly, P, Stoumbos, R, Zambrana, R

**期刊**: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES　|　**年份**: 2023　|　**DOI**: 10.1007/s11142-023-09795-4

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

我们发现证据表明，投资者根据其信任水平的不同而对股利有不同的估值。我们的检验表明，投资者对派息股票的需求随信任度下降而增加，且这一关系影响市场价值。我们首先呈现调查证据，表明人们认为派息公司发生会计舞弊的可能性较低，且信任度低的人更可能持有派息股票。随后我们在经验上利用某共同基金投资组合内部发现的会计舞弊作为对信任的冲击。在应对这些冲击时，我们表明共同基金会将其投资组合向派息股票倾斜。这一结果无法由风险偏好的转变来解释，表明这些机构投资者特别追求的是股利，而非恰好派息的稳定企业。最后，我们提供证据表明，当投资者基础变得信任度更低时，派息公司相对于不派息公司在市场价值上享有溢价。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We find evidence that investors value dividends differently depending on their level of trust. Our tests indicate that investor demand for dividend-paying stocks increases as trust decreases, and that this relationship affects market values. We begin with survey evidence showing that people think accounting fraud is less likely among dividend payers and that people with low trust are more likely to hold dividend-paying stocks. We then empirically exploit accounting fraud discoveries within a mutual fund's portfolio as a shock to trust. In response to these shocks, we show that mutual funds tilt their portfolios toward dividend-paying stocks. This result is not explained by a shift in risk preferences, indicating that these institutional investors are seeking dividends in particular rather than stable firms that just happen to pay dividends. Finally, we provide evidence that dividend payers experience a premium in their market values relative to non-payers when their investor base becomes less trusting.

**期刊**: AMERICAN ECONOMIC REVIEW　|　**年份**: 2023　|　**DOI**: 10.1257/aer.20221432

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(reform)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

Boissel与Matray（2022）发现，2013年之后，面临更高股利税的法国企业投资有所增加。我们识别出该研究在绘制这一改革对投资影响的事件研究代码中存在一处改动。使用相同的数据并移除这一改动后，我们发现处理组和对照组企业之间存在差异性的前趋势（pre-trends）。我们还证实，所有双重差分设定中使用的、被称为“规模增长”（size growth）的控制变量，实际上是对滞后投资（即主要结果变量）的控制。移除此类控制变量会减弱差异性前趋势，但没有留下清晰的事件研究证据表明股利税对投资有正向影响。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Boissel and Matray (2022) find that investment increased after 2013 in French firms facing higher dividend taxes. We identify an alteration in the code plotting the event study of the effect of this reform on investment. Using identical data and removing this alteration, we find differential pre-trends between treated and control firms. We also establish that the controls referred to as "size growth," used in all the difference-in-difference specifications, effectively are controls for lagged investment, i.e., the main outcome variable. Removing such controls attenuates differential pre-trends but leaves no clear event study evidence of a positive effect of dividend taxation on investment.

**【中文翻译】**

关于股利和公司所得税双重征税的争论由来已久。如果要避免双重征税，哪种税收政策更为理想？基于微观经济方法的传统企业理论无法给出确定的答案，因为任一政策都会扭曲企业投资并降低企业价值。与以往模型不同，本文在Laibson型双曲贴现模型下的宏观经济背景中探讨双重征税问题。特别地，本文表明，在双曲经济中，股利税可以改善消费者福利，尽管它降低了企业价值。另一方面，公司所得税同时对消费者和企业产生负面影响。我们还在一个无限期稳态模型中扩展了这一结果，并展示了定量含义。

Debates on the double taxation of dividends and corporate income have been long-standing. If double taxation were to be avoided, which type of tax policy would be more ideal? Conventional corporate the-ory based on microeconomic approaches does not yield a definitive answer, as either policy would distort firm investment and decrease firm value. Distinct from previous models, this paper addresses the dou-ble taxation issue in a macroeconomic context under a Laibson-type hyperbolic discounting model. In particular, this paper shows that in the hyperbolic economy, dividend taxes can improve consumer wel-fare, even though they decrease firm value. On the other hand, corporate income taxes negatively impact both consumers and firms. We also extend this result in an infinite-period steady-state model and show quantitative implications. 我们表明，个股、行业、商品、货币、全球政府债券和全球股票指数中价值策略的收益，在时间序列上可由各自的价值利差进行预测。在所有这些资产类别中，预期价值收益的变动幅度至少与其无条件水平相当。价值利差中的单一共同成分可解释约三分之二的价值收益可预测性，其余部分则为特定资产类别所特有。我们认为，价值溢价的共同变动与理性时变预期收益是一致的，因为：（一）共同价值成分与风险溢价的标准代理变量密切相关，例如股利收益率、中介机构杠杆和非流动性；（二）价值溢价在坏时期于全球范围内均处于高位。

A single common component of the value spreads captures about two-thirds of value return predictability and the remainder is asset class specific. We argue that common variation in value premia is consistent with rationally time-varying expected returns, because (i) common value is closely associated with standard proxies for risk premia, such as the dividend yield, intermediary leverage, and illiquidity, and (ii) value premia are globally high in bad times.

Rejected applicants were more likely to file for liquidation than successful applicants. These results remain even after we control for the primary benefits of the listing itself: liquidity and future capital inflows. **【中文翻译】**

**【英文摘要原文】**

Ownership structure plays a critical role in the incentives and behaviors of business organizations. The literature has focused on the effects of firm ownership dispersion across managers and investors. We extend the literature by examining the roles of ownership structure within a controlling family. Specifically, we focus on the family trust structure, which is a popular vehicle for holding family ownership around the world. The trust structure typically locks controlling ownership within a family for a very long period. Although it ensures family control, the share transfer restriction may induce family shirking problems, make family conflicts difficult to resolve, and distort firm decisions. Based on a sample of publicly traded family firms in Hong Kong, we report that trust-controlled firms that are more susceptible to these problems tend to pay higher dividends, invest less in the long term, and experience worse performance. The costs of using a trust structure are more significant when the family stakes have been locked inside the trust for a longer period and when a larger amount of family ownership is held by the trust.

The correct modeling of the discrete dividend is essential for a correct calculation of the early exercise boundary, as confirmed by theoretical insights. Pricing with stochastic volatility and jumps instead of the Black-Scholes-Merton benchmark cuts the amount lost by investors through suboptimal exercise by one-quarter. The remaining three-quarters are largely unexplained by transaction fees and may be interpreted as an opportunity cost for the investors to monitor optimal exercise.

Further analysis shows that firms pay a premium for networked directors. Firms that have suffered adverse events such as a bad merger, performance declines, or dividend cuts, pay a higher connection premium. ### 665. Taxing the multinational enterprise: On the forced redesign of global value chains and other inefficiencies

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Foss, NJ, Mudambi, R, Murtinu, S

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS STUDIES　|　**年份**: 2019　|　**DOI**: 10.1057/s41267-018-0159-3

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

跨国企业（MNE）的税收问题一直是政策制定者持续关注的问题。我们认为，流动性跨国企业不断变化的特性（例如其精细切分价值链并在地理上分散的能力提高），使得重新思考现行税收政策变得日益重要。首先，应更多关注当税收导致跨国企业活动低效布局时所产生的低效率。因此，跨国企业可能将活动转移到提供丰厚货币性和非货币性激励的低税收辖区，但这些辖区并不能使其投资对全球价值创造的贡献最大化。其次，国际税收制度应确保跨国企业为其对当地公共品的消费付费，而公共财政学者早已知道，当税收对象不可流动时，基于税收的扭曲最小。然而，当前大部分税收政策针对的是企业利润，而企业利润既不是当地公共品消费的良好代理变量，又极具流动性。通过整合国际商务、公共财政和经济地理学的理论，我们的分析表明，将税收归宿从企业利润转移到股利和消费上，将明确无误地同时改善财富创造和效率。

**【英文摘要原文】**

The taxation of the multinational enterprise (MNE) has been a continuing concern for policymakers. We argue that the changing nature of the mobile MNE (e.g., its improved ability to fine-slice the value chain and disperse it geographically) makes it increasingly important to rethink current tax policies. First, there should be more focus on the inefficiencies that arise when taxation leads to the inefficient location of MNE activities. Thus, MNEs may shift activities to low-tax jurisdictions that offer lucrative pecuniary and non-pecuniary incentives, but do not enable their investments to maximize their contribution to global value creation. Second, international tax regimes should ensure that MNEs pay for their consumption of local public goods, and public finance scholars have long known that the taxation-based distortions are minimized when the tax objects are immobile. However, the bulk of current tax policies are aimed at corporate profits that are both poor proxies for the consumption of local public goods as well as extremely mobile. Integrating theory from international business, public finance and economic geography, our analysis demonstrates that moving the incidence of taxation from corporate profits to dividends and consumption would unambiguously improve both wealth creation and efficiency.

### 666. The Dividend Disconnect

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Hartzmark, SM, Solomon, DH

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF FINANCE　|　**年份**: 2019　|　**DOI**: 10.1111/jofi.12785

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

许多个人投资者、共同基金和机构在交易时，仿佛股利和资本利得是彼此脱节的属性，而未能充分认识到股利会导致价格下跌。行为交易模式（例如处置效应）由价格变动而非总收益驱动。投资者很少将股利再投资，且交易时仿佛股利是一个独立、稳定的收入流。分析师未能考虑股利对价格的影响，从而对派息股票做出乐观的价格预测。在低利率和市场表现不佳的时期，对股利的需求会系统性地升高，从而导致派息股票的收益率下降。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Many individual investors, mutual funds, and institutions trade as if dividends and capital gains are disconnected attributes, not fully appreciating that dividends result in price decreases. Behavioral trading patterns (e.g., the disposition effect) are driven by price changes instead of total returns. Investors rarely reinvest dividends, and trade as if dividends are a separate, stable income stream. Analysts fail to account for the effect of dividends on price, leading to optimistic price forecasts for dividend-paying stocks. Demand for dividends is systematically higher in periods of low interest rates and poor market performance, leading to lower returns for dividend-paying stocks.

### 667. The impact of dividend imputation on corporate tax avoidance: The case of shareholder value

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: McClure, R, Lanis, R, Wells, P, Govendir, B

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF CORPORATE FINANCE　|　**年份**: 2018　|　**DOI**: 10.1016/j.jcorpfin.2017.10.007

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

本文的目的是评估股利抵免制度（据此可将企业已缴纳的公司税以税收抵免形式传递给股东）是否会影响企业避税。这一研究采用混合横截面研究设计，评估在企业避税激励存在显著差异的公司之间避税行为的差异。具体而言，潜在差异存在于以下三类公司之间：支付附带税收抵免股利的公司、支付不附带税收抵免股利的公司，以及不支付股利的公司。结果表明，支付附带税收抵免股利的公司更不太可能从事避税，其平均现金实际税率比支付不附带税收抵免股利的公司最多高出16.9个百分点，比完全不支付股利的公司最多高出14.7个百分点。据此，这为股利抵免制度在抑制企业避税方面的有效性提供了洞见，同时也为澳大利亚继续实施股利抵免制度提供了支持。此外，研究发现外部董事与企业避税之间存在正相关关系，这种关系延伸至那些支付附带税收抵免股利的公司，而股利抵免制度本应缓解此种关系。综合来看，这些结果表明避税的成本与收益具有异质性，这对于总体上评估企业税收激进程度，尤其是评估公司治理对企业避税的影响，构成了一项挑战。

**【英文摘要原文】**

The objective of this paper is to evaluate whether dividend imputation, whereby tax credits may be passed on to shareholders for corporate tax paid, impacts corporate tax avoidance. This is undertaken with a pooled cross-sectional research design evaluating differences in tax avoidance across firms where there are significant differences in corporate tax avoidance incentives. Specifically, potential differences arise between firms paying dividends with tax credits, paying dividends without tax credits, and not paying dividends. Results suggest that firms paying dividends with tax credits attached are less likely to engage in tax avoidance with an average cash effective tax rate up to 16.9 percentage points higher than firms that pay dividends without tax credits, and up to 14.7 percentage points higher than firms that do not pay dividends at all. Accordingly, this provides insights into the effectiveness of dividend imputation in mitigating corporate tax avoidance, as well as providing support for the continuance of dividend imputation in Australia. Additionally, a positive association is found to exist between outside directors and corporate tax avoidance, extending to firms paying dividends with tax credits where dividend imputation is expected to mitigate such a relation. In combination, these results suggest heterogeneity of costs and benefits of tax avoidance and this is a challenge in evaluating corporate tax aggressiveness generally, and the impact of corporate governance on corporate tax avoidance in particular. (C) 2017 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.

A simple general equilibrium model in which labor rigidity affects dividend dynamics and the price of short-run risk reconciles standard asset pricing facts with the term structures of the equity premium, volatility, and macroeconomic variables, which are at odds in leading models.

**期刊**: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE　|　**年份**: 2017　|　**DOI**: 10.1287/mnsc.2017.2786

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

我们提出了一种基于凸规划的方法，在离散时间框架下，以其他金融衍生品为参照，计算某一金融衍生品的最优超复制价格和次复制价格及其相应的对冲组合。我们的方法产生的模型能在任意精度内匹配超复制（或次复制）价格，并与其他金融衍生品价格保持一致。应用范围包括：以各种执行价和到期日的看涨期权价格对远期开始期权、波动率与方差互换及衍生品、棘轮式看涨期权、障碍期权以及回望期权和亚式期权进行稳健复制。数值算例表明，在某些情形下，最优超复制和/或次复制价格与标准模型所得价格相差在10%以内，但在其他情形下则与之相差甚远。我们的方法可纳入买卖价差、利率和股利，以及扩散模型的各种局限。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We give a method based on convex programming to calculate the optimal super-replicating and subreplicating prices and corresponding hedging portfolios of a financial derivative in terms of other financial derivatives in a discrete-time setting. Our method produces a model that matches the superreplicating (or subreplicating) price within an arbitrary precision and is consistent with the other financial derivatives prices. Applications include robust replication in terms of call prices with various strikes and maturities of forward start options, volatility and variance swaps and derivatives, cliquet calls, barrier options, and lookback and Asian options. Numerical examples show that, in some cases, the best superreplicating and/or subreplicating prices are within 10% of the price obtained by a standard model but considerably differ from it in other cases. Our method can incorporate bid-ask spreads, interest rates and dividends, and various limitations to the diffusion model.

### 673. Spillovers Inside Conglomerates: Incentives and Capital

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Duchin, R, Goldberg, A, Sosyura, D

**期刊**: REVIEW OF FINANCIAL STUDIES　|　**年份**: 2017　|　**DOI**: 10.1093/rfs/hhw095

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(governance)；股利政策(distribution)

**【中文翻译】**

利用手工搜集的关于综合性企业集团中各分部管理者的数据，我们发现，某一分部所在行业薪酬的变化会对同一企业其他分部管理者的薪酬产生溢出效应。这些溢出效应仅存在于综合性企业集团的边界之内。当企业集团拥有过剩现金、且管理者对其分配拥有更大影响力时，企业内部溢出效应增强；但在治理强健的情况下则减弱。这些溢出效应与较弱的业绩和较低的企业价值相关。我们的证据与通过管理者薪酬和资本预算同时进行交叉补贴相一致，并表明这些做法出现在特征相似的企业中。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Using hand-collected data on divisional managers at conglomerates, we find that a change in industry pay in one division generates spillovers on managerial pay in other divisions of the same firm. These spillovers arise only within the boundaries of a conglomerate. The intra-firm spillovers increase when conglomerates have excess cash and when managers have more influence over its distribution, but decline in the presence of strong governance. These spillovers are associated with weaker performance and lower firm value. Our evidence is consistent with simultaneous cross-subsidization via managerial compensation and capital budgets and suggests that these practices arise in similar firms.

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF FINANCE　|　**年份**: 2017　|　**DOI**: 10.1111/jofi.12472

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(institution)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

我们利用机构交易数据，考察熟练的机构投资者是否利用了正的除息日异常收益。结果表明，机构投资者将交易集中在某些除息日附近，并在这些事件周围赚取更高的利润。股利捕获交易占所有机构买入交易的6%，却贡献了整体异常收益的15%。机构的股利捕获交易具有持续性。机构在除息日的盈利能力还与其交易执行技能存在强烈的横截面相关性。而在安慰剂式的非除息日周围，执行技能与利润之间的关系消失。结果表明，熟练的机构瞄准特定机会，而非在时间上均匀受益。此外，只有熟练的机构才能从股利捕获中获利。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We use institutional trading data to examine whether skilled institutions exploit positive abnormal ex-dividend returns. Results show that institutions concentrate trading around certain ex-dates, and earn higher profits around these events. Dividend capture trades represent 6% of all institutional buy trades but contribute 15% of overall abnormal returns. Institutional dividend capture trading is persistent. Institutional ex-day profitability is also strongly cross-sectionally related to trade execution skill. The relation between execution skill and profits disappears around placebo non-ex-days. Results suggest that skilled institutions target certain opportunities rather than benefiting uniformly over time. Furthermore, only skilled institutions can profit from dividend capture.

**【中文翻译】**

债务融资的股票回购能产生正的短期和长期异常股票收益。相比现金融资的回购企业，杠杆回购企业事前拥有更大的债务容量、更高的边际税率、更低的过剩现金和更低的成长前景，事后则更大幅度地增加杠杆并削减投资。事前杠杆过高的企业在杠杆回购后与较低的收益和实际投资相关。杠杆过高企业较低的公告收益集中于公司治理较弱的企业。这些证据与如下观点相一致：杠杆回购使企业能够优化其杠杆，平均而言使股东受益。但随着企业事前杠杆的升高，这些收益递减。

Firms that are over-levered ex-ante are associated with lower returns and real investments following leveraged buybacks. The lower announcement returns of over-levered firms are concentrated on firms with weaker corporate governance. The evidence is consistent with leveraged buybacks enabling firms to optimize their leverage, on average benefiting shareholders. The benefits decrease with a firm's leverage ex ante. **期刊**: JOURNAL OF FINANCE　|　**年份**: 2016　|　**DOI**: 10.1111/jofi.12246

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

本文从一位贝叶斯主体的视角刻画了美国的消费动态，该主体并不知晓底层的模型结构，而是随时间从宏观经济数据中学习。现实的、高维的宏观经济学习问题涉及参数学习、模型学习和状态学习，与标准的完全信息理性预期基准相比，会生成关于消费动态的显著不同的主观信念。关于长期动态的信念是波动的，具有逆周期的条件波动率，并随时间漂移。将这些信念嵌入一个标准资产定价模型，显著提高了该模型匹配典型事实以及市场价格-股利比样本路径的能力。

**【英文摘要原文】**

This paper characterizes U.S. consumption dynamics from the perspective of a Bayesian agent who does not know the underlying model structure but learns over time from macroeconomic data. Realistic, high-dimensional macroeconomic learning problems, which entail parameter, model, and state learning, generate substantially different subjective beliefs about consumption dynamics compared to the standard, full-information rational expectations benchmark. Beliefs about long-run dynamics are volatile, with counter-cyclical conditional volatility, and drift over time. Embedding these beliefs in a standard asset pricing model significantly improves the model's ability to match the stylized facts, as well as the sample path of the market price-dividend ratio.

### 677. Understanding Cross-Country Differences in Valuation Ratios: A Variance Decomposition Approach

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Chue, TK

**期刊**: CONTEMPORARY ACCOUNTING RESEARCH　|　**年份**: 2015　|　**DOI**: 10.1111/1911-3846.12127

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

我们采用方差分解方法，考察总体估值比率为何在国家之间存在差异。在1980至2009年间22个发达国家的横截面中，我们发现总体市账率（P/B）的所有跨国差异中，有50%可由预期未来五年盈利能力的跨国差异来解释。在我们样本期的后半段，这一比例超过了前半段，升至近64%。尽管会计准则和惯例的国际差异可能使不同国家的盈利相比股利更难比较，但我们发现，与国际估值比率差异更密切相关的，仍然是预期未来盈利能力的跨国差异，而非股利增长率。即便在25个新兴市场中，我们也发现五年期预期未来盈利能力可解释所有跨国P/B变动的29%。我们的结果表明，国际投资者能够识别未来盈利前景的重大跨国差异，并将其纳入股票市场估值。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We use a variance decomposition approach to examine why aggregate valuation ratios differ across countries. In a cross-section of 22 developed countries from 1980 to 2009, we find that 50 percent of all cross-country differences in the aggregate price-to-book ratio (P/B) can be explained by cross-country differences in expected future five-year profitability. In the second half of our sample period, this percentage exceeds that of the first half, rising to almost 64 percent. Although international differences in accounting standards and conventions may have made earnings from different countries more difficult to compare relative to dividends, we find that it is still cross-country differences in expected future profitability, rather than dividend growth rates, that are more closely related to international differences in valuation ratios. Even among 25 emerging markets, we find that expected future profitability at the five-year horizon can account for 29 percent of all cross-country P/B variations. Our results show that international investors are able to identify substantial cross-country differences in future-earnings prospects and incorporate them into stock market valuations.

**【中文翻译】**

我们为股利税资本化的横截面差异提供了一种新的解释。我们的分析有两方面。首先，我们进行了理论分析，表明流动性（非流动性）会缓解（放大）先前文献所记录的股利税对预期收益率的正向影响。其次，我们围绕2003年《就业与增长税收减免协调法案》进行了实证分析，该法案缩小了最高法定股利税率与资本利得税率之间的差异，我们发现结果与我们的理论相一致。我们还提供了结果表明，先前研究所记录的机构持股对股利税资本化的缓解效应，可归因于机构持股更高的股票流动性更强，而非归因于"边际投资者"对股利税不敏感。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We provide a new explanation for cross-sectional variation in dividend tax capitalization. Our analysis is twofold. First, we conduct a theoretical analysis that shows that liquidity (illiquidity) mitigates (magnifies) the positive effect of dividend taxes on expected rates of return documented in prior literature. Second, we conduct an empirical analysis centered around the Jobs and Growth Tax Relief and Reconciliation Act of 2003, which reduced the difference between the maximum statutory dividend and capital gains tax rates, and find results consistent with our theory. We also provide results suggesting that institutional ownership's mitigating effect on dividend tax capitalization documented in prior studies is attributable to stocks with greater institutional ownership being more liquid and not to the "marginal investor" being insensitive to dividend taxes.

### 679. Can Noise Create the Size and Value Effects?

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Arnott, RD, Hsu, JC, Liu, J, Markowitz, H

**期刊**: MANAGEMENT SCIENCE　|　**年份**: 2015　|　**DOI**: 10.1287/mnsc.2014.1995

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

如果一只股票的价格与其内在价值相差一个随机噪声，那么价值股更有可能带有负噪声；因此它们更有可能被低估，其预期收益高于风险所应有的水平。同样的直觉也适用于小市值股票。我们运用一个标准的价格噪声模型，正式地验证并探究了这一直觉。这一直觉不同于Blume和Stambaugh（1983）所研究的詹森不等式效应。我们的模型十分简约：价值溢价和规模溢价均以闭式解形式计算得出，且仅取决于四个参数：股票收益的均值、股票收益的波动率、价格-股利比的波动率，以及噪声波动率。我们强调，只需适度的价格噪声波动率即可产生观测到的价值溢价。然而，该模型无法产生观测到的规模溢价。

**【英文摘要原文】**

If the price of a stock differs from its intrinsic value by a random noise, then value stocks are more likely to have negative noise; they are thus more likely undervalued and have higher expected return than justified by risk. The same intuition applies to small capitalization stocks. We formally verify and explore this intuition by using a standard noise-in-price model. This intuition is different from the Jensen's inequality effect studied by Blume and Stambaugh [Blume ME, Stambaugh RF (1983) Biases in computed returns: An application to the size effect. J. Financial Econom. 12(3):387-404]. Our model is parsimonious: the value premium as well as size premium are computed in closed form and depend on only four parameters: mean of stock return, volatility of stock return, volatility of the price-to-dividend ratio, and noise volatility. We emphasize that only a moderate volatility of price noise is needed to generate the observed value premium. However, the model cannot generate the observed size premium.

《多德-弗兰克法案》中"薪酬话语权"（SOP）条款的经济价值一直是争论的主题。该条款的支持者认为，这些投票通过增强投资者对管理者薪酬的影响力而使股东受益。SOP条款的反对者则认为，薪酬契约应由信息充分且不受阻碍的董事会来完成。我们的研究通过考察对投票的反应，为股东SOP投票的影响提供了直接证据。我们发现，SOP支持率低的过度受薪管理者往往通过增加股利、降低杠杆和增加企业投资来做出反应。然而，我们没有发现证据表明管理层对投票的反应会影响后续的投票结果，也没有发现企业价值随后发生变化。最后，我们发现，对于那些在SOP投票之前被大幅超额支付的管理者，其超额薪酬会增加，无论投票结果如何。因此，SOP立法似乎并未达到改善高管契约的预期效果。

The economic value of the Say-On-Pay (SOP) provision of the Dodd-Frank Act has been a subject of debate. Proponents of this provision suggest these votes benefit shareholders by increasing investor influence over managerial compensation. Opponents of the SOP provision believe compensation contracting is better done by well-informed and unobstructed boards of directors. Our study provides direct evidence on the impact of the shareholder SOP votes by examining responses to the vote. We find that overcompensated managers with low SOP support tend to react by increasing dividends, decreasing leverage and increasing corporate investment. However, we find no evidence that management's response to the vote affects subsequent vote outcomes, nor do we find a subsequent change in firm value. Finally, we find excess compensation increases for managers that were substantially overpaid prior to the SOP vote, regardless of the outcome of the vote. Thus, it does not appear that the SOP legislation has had the intended effect of improving executive contracting. (C) 2014 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.

利用新的月度数据，我们考察了美国企业的公开市场回购执行情况。我们发现，企业以显著低于平均市场价格的价格进行回购。这一价格折扣与规模负相关，与市账率正相关。企业的回购活动之后跟随着正的、显著的异常收益。重要的是，市场反应发生在企业于盈利公告中披露其实际回购数据之时，而这一正向反应之后跟随着一个持续1个月的漂移。与这些结果相一致，我们发现内部人交易与实际回购正相关。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Using new monthly data, we investigate open-market repurchase executions of US firms. We find that firms repurchase at prices that are significantly lower than average market prices. This price discount is negatively related to size and positively related to market-to-book ratio. Firms' repurchase activity is followed by a positive and significant abnormal return. Importantly, the market response occurs when firms disclose their actual repurchase data in earnings announcements, and this positive response is followed by a 1-month drift. Consistent with these results, we find that insider trading is positively related to actual repurchases.

The dividend-price ratio is a noisy proxy for expected returns when expected dividend growth is time-varying. This paper uses a new and forward-looking measure of dividend growth extracted from S&P 500 futures and options to correct the dividend-price ratio for changes in expected dividend growth. Over January 1994 through June 2011, dividend growth implied by derivative markets reliably forecasts future dividend growth, and the corrected dividend-price ratio predicts S&P 500 returns substantially better than the standard dividend-price ratio, in-sample and out-of-sample. Time-varying expected dividend growth is important to explain price movements, especially because it is highly correlated with expected returns.

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

动量效应是否自然地源于市场均衡中资产价格的决定？我们在递归偏好下校准了一个包含多种资产的标准禀赋模型。动量效应部分来自投资者对消费风险的厌恶。一次未预期到的股利增加会产生正收益，并提高该资产在消费中的占比，从而提高其未来股利增长与消费增长之间的相关性。这一相关性由更高的预期收益予以补偿，从而产生动量效应。预期收益的横截面差异也是一个关键贡献因素。经量化的模型产生了可观的动量利润，往往接近观测到的利润。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Does the momentum effect arise naturally from the determination of asset prices in market equilibrium? We calibrate a standard endowment model of multiple assets under recursive preferences. The momentum effect partly comes from investors' aversion to consumption risks. An unexpected dividend increase generates a positive return and increases the asset's proportion of consumption, raising the correlation between its future dividend growth and consumption growth. This is compensated by a higher expected return, generating the momentum effect. The cross-sectional difference in expected returns is also a key contributor. The quantified model produces sizable momentum profits, often close to the observed profits.

### 687. Dynamic risk, accounting-based valuation and firm fundamentals

**作者**: Lyle, MR, Callen, JL, Elliott, RJ

**期刊**: REVIEW OF ACCOUNTING STUDIES　|　**年份**: 2013　|　**DOI**: 10.1007/s11142-013-9227-x

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

本研究将Ohlson（1995）以及Feltham和Ohlson（1999）的基于会计的估值框架加以扩展，纳入了关于经济中系统性风险水平的动态预期。我们的模型解释了近期记录经济范围内风险变化与未来股票收益之间存在强负相关的实证发现。重要的是，该模型还生成了完全为会计变量和其他企业基本面（包括账市比、盈利-价格比、前瞻盈利-价格比、规模和股利收益率）的线性函数的资本成本。这一结果为会计和金融文献将这些流行变量纳入资本成本（预期收益）计算提供了理论依据，并免除了从不可观测的（未来）协方差中估计资本成本的需要。该模型还生成了一种秉承Vuolteenaho（2002）精神的会计收益分解。实证上，我们发现，与标准基准模型形成对比的是，由我们模型生成的资本成本在样本内和样本外都与未来收益显著相关。我们还在样本外检验中获得了比忽略动态风险预期的传统模型显著更低的估值误差。

**【英文摘要原文】**

This study extends the accounting-based valuation framework of Ohlson (Contemp Acc Res 11(2):661-687, 1995) and Feltham and Ohlson (Acc Rev 74(2):165-183, 1999) to incorporate dynamic expectations about the level of systematic risk in the economy. Our model explains recent empirical findings documenting a strong negative association between changes in economy-wide risk and future stock returns. Importantly, the model also generates costs of capital that are solely a linear function of accounting variables and other firm fundamentals, including the book-to-market ratio, the earnings-to-price ratio, the forward earnings-to-price ratio, size and the dividend yield. This result provides a theoretical rationale for the inclusion of these popular variables in cost of capital (expected return) computations by the accounting and finance literatures and obviates the need to estimate costs of capital from unobservable (future) covariances. The model also generates an accounting return decomposition in the spirit of Vuolteenaho (J Finance 57(1):233-264, 2002). Empirically, we find that costs of capital generated by our model are significantly associated with future returns both in and out of sample in contrast to standard benchmark models. We further obtain significantly lower valuation errors in out-of-sample tests than traditional models that ignore dynamic risk expectations.

We present the puzzling evidence that, from 1962 to 2009, an average 10.2% of large public nonfinancial US firms have zero debt and almost 22% have less than 5% book leverage ratio. Dividend-paying zero-leverage firms pay substantially higher dividends, are more profitable, pay higher taxes, issue less equity, and have higher cash balances than control firms chosen by industry and size. Firms with higher Chief Executive Officer (CEO) ownership and longer CEO tenure are more likely to have zero debt, especially if boards are smaller and less independent. Family firms are also more likely to be zero-levered. (C) 2013 Published by Elsevier B.V.

**【中文翻译】**

制造商管理着彼此关联的物料流和现金流。物料需要资本，销售贡献现金。因此，协调运营决策与财务决策可能是有益的。我们研究了一个股权融资企业中协调的动态模型，其中在需求不确定性、财务约束和违约风险存在的情况下，存货决策与财务决策相互作用。其准则是使股利净额（扣除资本认购后）的预期现值最大化。最优目标存货水平和财务决策变量是存货水平与留存收益水平的非递减函数。无论违约触发的是第7章还是第11章破产，最优政策的一些重要属性保持不变。最优政策是近视的，并且如果相关成本函数是分段线性的，则该政策可用简单公式加以刻画。我们表明，存货理论的方法在分析运营与财务协调模型时是有用的。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Manufacturers manage interrelated flows of material and cash. Material needs capital, and sales contribute cash. Therefore, it may be beneficial to coordinate operational and financial decisions. We study a dynamic model of coordination in an equity-financed firm in which inventory and financial decisions interact in the presence of demand uncertainty, financial constraints, and a risk of default. The criterion is to maximize the expected present value of dividends net of capital subscriptions. The optimal target inventory level and financial decision variables are nondecreasing functions of the levels of inventory and retained earnings. Some important attributes of an optimal policy remain the same regardless of whether default precipitates Chapter 7 or Chapter 11 bankruptcy. The optimal policy is myopic, and if pertinent cost functions are piecewise linear, it is characterized with simple formulas. We show that the methods of inventory theory are useful in analyzing models of operational and financial coordination.

**期刊**: OPERATIONS RESEARCH　|　**年份**: 2013　|　**DOI**: 10.1287/opre.1120.1140

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

计算多目标数学规划的非支配集，长期以来一直是多准则决策中的一个课题。在本文中，出于将马科维茨证券组合选择扩展到额外一个线性准则（股利、流动性、可持续性等）的意愿，我们展示了一种精确方法，用于计算一个三准则规划的非支配集，该规划除其目标之一为最小化一个凸二次函数外，其余全部为线性。由于所得的二次-线性-线性规划的非支配集是一个由弯曲小片组成的曲面，我们设计了一种多参数算法来计算这些小片，以便能够精确绘制它们。通过这种方式，可以展示三准则非支配曲面的图形，从而如同传统证券组合选择那样，在全面审视所有其他最优候选者的同时选出最偏好的组合。最后，通过给出一个针对社会责任投资者的算例，我们证明我们的算法在多准则决策情形下能够胜过标准的组合策略。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Computing the nondominated set of a multiple objective mathematical program has long been a topic in multiple criteria decision making. In this paper, motivated by the desire to extend Markowitz portfolio selection to an additional linear criterion (dividends, liquidity, sustainability, etc.), we demonstrate an exact method for computing the nondominated set of a tri-criterion program that is all linear except for the fact that one of its objectives is to minimize a convex quadratic function. With the nondominated set of the resulting quad-lin-lin program being a surface composed of curved platelets, a multiparametric algorithm is devised for computing the platelets so that they can be graphed precisely. In this way, graphs of the tri-criterion nondominated surface can be displayed so that, as in traditional portfolio selection, a most preferred portfolio can be selected while in full view of all other contenders for optimality. Finally, by giving an example for socially responsible investors, we demonstrate that our algorithm can outperform standard portfolio strategies for multicriterial decision makers.

Singapore Airlines is widely regarded as an exemplar of excellence in an industry whose service standards are tumbling. What's not so well known is that the company is also one of the civil aviation industry's cost leaders. SIA's success in executing a dual strategy of differentiation and cost leadership is unusual. Indeed, management experts, such as Michael Porter, argue that it's impossible to do so for a sustained period since dual strategies entail contradictory investments and organizational processes. Yet SIA, and a few other emerging-economy companies, view the dualities as opposites that form part of a whole. SIA executes its dual strategy by managing four paradoxes: Achieving service excellence cost-effectively, fostering centralized and decentralized innovation, being a technology leader and follower, and using standardization to achieve personalization. The results speak for themselves: SIA has delivered healthy financial returns; it has never had an annual loss; and except for the initial capitalization, the Asian airline has funded its growth itself while paying dividends every year.

### 697. A Long-Run Risks Model of Asset Pricing with Fat Tails

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

We explore the effects of fat tails on the equilibrium implications of the long-run risks model of asset pricing by introducing innovations with dampened power law to consumption and dividends growth processes. We estimate the model structural parameters by maximum likelihood. We find that the stochastic volatility model with fat tails can generate implied risk premium, expected risk free rate and their volatilities comparable to the magnitudes observed in data. The model with fat tails leads to a significant increase in implied risk premia over the benchmark Gaussian model, but similar values for other equilibrium quantities of interest.

### 698. Lost in translation: Delayed ex-dividend price adjustments of Hong Kong ADRs

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Kadapakkam, PR, Meisami, A, Shi, YL

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF BANKING & FINANCE　|　**年份**: 2010　|　**DOI**: 10.1016/j.jbankfin.2009.09.001

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(law)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

以往研究记录，香港股票具有与股利和资本利得均免税相一致的完全除息价格调整。我们考察香港ADR（美国存托凭证）的除息价格行为，以评估美国和香港不同税收环境的影响。这些ADR通常在其标的股票之前除息。它们在除息日经历了1.16%的显著异常收益：平均除息日价格下跌仅为股利的30%。然而，当标的股票随后除息时，ADR价格会下跌。ADR的累计价格下跌等于股利。因此，ADR的除息调整与其标的股票的调整相似，这与由母国税法主导ADR价格行为相一致。流动性和交易成本都无法解释ADR这种反常的延迟除息调整。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Previous research documents that Hong Kong stocks have a full ex-dividend price adjustment consistent with dividends and capital gains being tax free. We examine ex-dividend price behavior of Hong Kong ADRs to assess the impact of differing tax environments in US and Hong Kong. These ADRs typically go ex-dividend before their underlying stock. They experience significant abnormal returns of 1.16% on their ex-day: the average ex-day price drop is only 30% of the dividend. However, ADR prices drop when the underlying stock goes ex-dividend subsequently. The cumulative ADR price drop is equal to the dividend. Thus, the ADR ex-dividend adjustment resembles that of the underlying stock, consistent with home country tax laws governing ADR price behavior. Neither liquidity nor transaction costs can explain the anomalous delayed ex-dividend adjustment of ADRs. (C) 2009 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.

### 699. The q-Theory Approach to Understanding the Accrual Anomaly

**相关性得分**: 3.0分

**作者**: Wu, J, Zhang, L, Zhang, XF

**期刊**: JOURNAL OF ACCOUNTING RESEARCH　|　**年份**: 2010　|　**DOI**: 10.1111/j.1475-679X.2009.00353.x

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(standard)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

将应计项目诠释为营运资本投资，我们基于q理论假设企业会响应贴现率变化而最优地调整其应计项目。较高的贴现率意味着盈利性较低的投资和较低的应计项目，而较低的贴现率意味着盈利性较高的投资和较高的应计项目。我们的证据支持这一最优投资假说：（1）在标准因子回归中加入一个投资因子会大幅降低应计异象的量级，往往降至不显著的水平；（2）应计项目与来自股利贴现模型的贴现率估计负协变，并且在很大程度上也与来自剩余收益模型的估计负协变；（3）会计可靠性低的应计项目与资本投资的协变程度高于会计可靠性高的应计项目；以及（4）应计交易策略的预期收益是时变的，这表明近年来应计效应的减弱可能是暂时的，且很可能在不久的将来均值回复。

**【英文摘要原文】**

Interpreting accruals as working capital investment, we hypothesize based on q-theory that firms optimally adjust their accruals in response to discount rate changes. A higher discount rate means less profitable investments and lower accruals, and a lower discount rate means more profitable investments and higher accruals. Our evidence supports this optimal investment hypothesis: (1) adding an investment factor into standard factor regressions substantially reduces the magnitude of the accrual anomaly, often to insignificant levels; (2) accruals covary negatively with discount rate estimates from the dividend discounting model, and for the most part, with estimates from the residual income model; (3) accruals with low accounting reliability covary more with capital investment than accruals with high accounting reliability; and (iv) expected returns to accruals-based trading strategies are time-varying, suggesting that the deterioration of the accrual effect in recent years might be temporary and likely to mean-revert in the near future.

**匹配关键词**: 监管/治理(policy)；股利政策(dividend)

**【中文翻译】**

我们考察了看涨期权在标的股票除息日前后的行为。证据与理性行权政策的预测不一致；相当大一部分未平仓合约仍未被行权，从而给期权卖方带来意外收益。这触发了一种精巧的交易方案，使短期交易者能够获得这些收益的相当一部分。该交易方案抬高了报告的成交量，并扭曲了其与流动性之间的传统关系。在最后一个含息日成交量的急剧增加，是由各期权交易所通过的对交易成本的限制所促成的。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We examine the behavior of call options surrounding the underlying stock's ex-dividend date. The evidence is inconsistent with the predictions of a rational exercise policy; a significant fraction of the open interest remains unexercised, resulting in a windfall gain to option writers. This triggers a sophisticated trading scheme that enables short-term traders to receive a significant fraction of the gains. The trading scheme inflates reported volume and distorts its traditional relations to liquidity. The dramatic increases in the volume of trade on the last cum-dividend day are facilitated by limitations on transaction costs passed by the various option exchanges.

**【中文翻译】**

我们研究了引入一种非冗余衍生品对股票市场收益波动率和局部无风险利率波动率的影响。我们的分析使用了一个标准的、无摩擦的、完全信息的、动态的、连续时间的一般均衡Lucas禀赋经济，其中存在两类主体，他们具有时间可加的幂效用函数，仅在风险厌恶程度上有所不同。我们的主要结果是解析地表明，如果预防性储蓄需求的强度不太高，那么引入非冗余衍生品会增加股票市场收益的波动率。此外，在带有衍生品的经济中，股票市场收益的波动率可以大大超过总股利增长的波动率（基本面波动率）。我们还表明，局部无风险利率的波动率会随衍生品的引入而增加。

**【英文摘要原文】**

We study the effect of introducing a nonredundant derivative on the volatilities of the stock market return and the locally risk-free interest rate. Our analysis uses a standard, frictionless, full-information, dynamic, continuous-time, general-equilibrium, Lucas endowment economy in which there are two classes of agents who have time-additive power utility functions and differ only in their risk aversion. Our main result is to show analytically that if the intensity of the precautionary demand for savings is not too high, then the introduction of a nonredundant derivative increases the volatility of stock market returns. Furthermore, in the economy with the derivative, the volatility of stock market returns can be substantially greater than that of aggregate dividend growth (fundamental volatility). We also show that the volatility of the locally risk-free interest rate increases with the introduction of the derivative.

### 702. Capital structure and international debt shifting
